title: Recon, Prerequisite & Live Supabase Schema Verification
description: Verify workspace environment variables (.env without leaking secrets), inspect 0001_init_schema.up.sql vs Go entity structs, verify Go/Node/pnpm/Rust toolchains, and test live TCP/SQL connectivity and provisioned schema against Supabase PostgreSQL.

Confirm .env defines DATABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_URL, and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

Baseline unit tests pass before modifications
